name: National Food Equipment Services
old_description: Founded in 1973, National Food Equipment Services (NFES) has built a reputation for delivering exceptional service and support to the foodservice industry. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, NFES provides commercial kitchen equipment repair and maintenance, HVAC services, and equipment sales.
about:
National Food Equipment Services (NFES) was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. The company operates as a service provider for the foodservice industry, though details about its founders or ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

NFES specializes in commercial kitchen equipment repair and maintenance, HVAC services, and equipment sales. Its service portfolio covers ventilation, heating and cooling, and a wide range of food preparation equipment including ovens, fryers, combi ovens, refrigeration systems, ice machines, and walk-in coolers. The company offers both reactive repair and preventive maintenance programs, along with warranty and emergency after-hours support. Technicians serve customers across much of North Carolina, including Charlotte, Raleigh, and Greensboro.

The company serves restaurants, corporate dining operations, colleges and universities, K-12 schools, healthcare facilities and hospitals, assisted living communities, entertainment venues, and hospitality businesses.

NFES emphasizes expert, on-time maintenance and repair to keep commercial kitchens running smoothly. It positions itself as a single source for commercial ventilation and HVAC services, backed by warranty service availability and emergency response capabilities.
